title: Cross-Modality Accessibility Verdict
scientific_claim_target: qualified cross_modality boundary without score pooling channel equivalence model transfer device extrapolation or home claim
scientific_claim_ceiling: A future clean artifact-only verdict may state which exact engineering interfaces and independently proven capability levels are shared or modality-specific across named cryogenic MEG and scalp EEG evidence. It cannot create neural advantage, transfer, equivalence, causal latency, portable hardware, at-home, patient, assistive, or clinical evidence.

primary_source_findings.finding: EEG records electric fields and MEG records magnetic fields. The published devices used 61 EEG plus three ocular channels versus 102 magnetometers plus 204 planar gradiometers, so shared task vocabulary does not imply shared channel semantics.

Brain2Qwerty v1 reported mean sentence CER of 29 percent for MEG and 65 percent for EEG under its own cohort model preprocessing split and language context. These are external conditional results, not local thresholds or pooled modality scores.

The official v2 project page says v2 removes individual keypress timing and generates sentences from continuous MEG recordings. Continuous input is a distinct capability from causal incremental output.

Brain2Qwerty v2 uses 306-channel cryogenic MEG and states that the current architecture is noncausal works with an entire sentence and has slow real-time latency. It is not EEG OPM home or causal streaming evidence.
BIDS distinguishes EEG electrodes from recorded channels and requires the EEG reference scheme and sampling frequency while preserving units filters channel order and channel-specific reference.
BIDS distinguishes MEG magnetometers axial and planar gradiometers reference sensors and non-MEG auxiliary channels. Equal tensor dimensions cannot establish sensor equivalence.

Cyton documents 250 Hz packets with a sample counter eight 24-bit channels six auxiliary bytes and a footer. Packet mechanics do not establish EEG configuration signal quality task information or decoding.

current_warnings: Published Brain2Qwerty v1 EEG and MEG scores are external cohort results and cannot define a local threshold or cross-modality ratio.
Brain2Qwerty v2 removes keypress onset dependence but remains noncausal and sentence-level; continuous input is not measured causal real-time output.
The local S21 and S7 tiny model results are both negative but are not a matched modality comparison.
The historical S7 extractor removed EOG-named channels and is ineligible for the fresh Loop54 and Loop55 claim path.
S20 remains unopened and fresh EEG signal quality trial integrity and neural effect are unavailable.
OpenBCI Cyton is a Q0 specification candidate only and no device is known to be present or qualified.
Shared cache report metric and causal interfaces establish software mechanics only.
